newsitem.title: THAILAND: Tipco Asphalt records loss on Finance One shares.
newsitem.headline: Tipco Asphalt records loss on Finance One shares.

text.p: Thai construction materials and asphalt supplier Tipco Asphalt Plc has lost 307.09 million baht ($12.28 million) from sales of Finance One Plc shares, the company said on Thursday.

The company said it sold 2.50 million common shares, or about 0.60 percent of Finance One Plc stock at 7.164 baht per shares when the stock of the troubled finance company resumed trading earlier this week.
Tipco said it had purchased the stake in what was formerly Thailand's leading finance firm at 130 baht per share.
The loss will be booked in the second quarter this year, Tipco said in a statment.
The firm was one of four institutional investors known to have bought shares in a Finance One Plc private share placement in January 1995 at betwen 130 and 150 baht per share.
The Government of Singapore Investment Corp, Thai telcommunications firm United Communications Plc and contractor Italian-Thai Development Plc also bought into the issue.

Finance One Plc, which recently saw a planned merger with commercial bank Thai Danu Bank Plc collapse, has seen the value of its stock plummet as investors have become increasingly concerned about the company's financial strength.
Many Thai finance firms are faced with deteriorating asset quality, falling revenues and rising funding costs. ($1 = 26 baht)
